title: Wells Fargo Supports Flexible Supportive Housing
description: Thanks to Wells Fargo for supporting Volunteers of America's flexible supportive housing programs. These residents are all grateful for their now brighter futures.

asr.full_text: What it means to me is self-sufficient freedom. It means that I'm going back on my way to finding employment, pulling my family back together,. And becoming the self sufficient person that I was once before. It means a lot to me because if it wasn't for this program,. I would still be on the street trying to figure out what my next move would be. When a tenant sees their apartment for the first time, it makes them feel wonderful. Sometimes over enjoying because they can't believe that this is happening to them. I'm home! Come on. What do you think? To actually have the keys to my own place and that I have my own bathroom, it's amazing because it's been a struggle for like a year. My first reaction was, it was surreal. I couldn't believe that it was actually something that was done out of the kindness of other. People's hearts and something that was able to provide me with the stability that I needed. To pull myself back together and heal and come to the point where I'm at now. Um, yay! I don't have to live out there anymore. I cried. I'm finally over it. I felt so lucky. I was like, I have the opportunity to live a lifetime right here. But I mean, just more like it was my, you know, it's my place, my space where I could. Feel safe. And that's more anything is just, I don't know if people even understand it. It's like, it feels so freaking great just to be able to be like, I'm safe. I was like, yes, finally, I'm off the streets. I was like, I was just in shock. Now that I have housing, I see a future. I did not see a future before. So, it was blank. It's given me more than what I've ever thought of. It's given me that, you know, hand up instead of a hand out. Now that I have a stable environment, my son can come visit and actually be around me and. Actually just be able to sit here and pursue my career. I just really want to say thank you for the opportunity and now I can live as a quote. Unquote happily ever after. You.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents Wells Fargo's support for Volunteers of America's supportive housing programs. The speakers describe receiving housing, safety, employment opportunities, and family connection, while the visuals identify the housing coordinator and both organizations. These cues indicate a program testimonial rather than a financial or data solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content concerns an ordinary supportive housing service and its described benefits, including housing, safety and stability; no scam mechanism is evidenced.
